Portfolio, thirteen ways

Same facts, same identity, thirteen structures: what is primary, what is the spine, how the arc, the life beyond, and the helm are arranged. Judge structure. Advance, kill, or say what to steal.

P1 — The investor's ledgertable is the spine

book strip · positions table · drawer for the selected position · signals column

P2 — The arc is the spinetime is the primary axis

one shared time axis 2025 Q3 → now · each position a track with its dated arc · signals hang on the axis

P3 — The wall of small multiplesone chart per position

nine panes of claimed vs observed, sorted by residual · selection opens the full position beneath

P4 — One position dominantthe lot

opens on the position needing a hand, drawn large · rail of nine on the left

P5 — The estate is the bookownership is the axis

patents, licences, deals as the hero; positions as owners of their IP

P6 — The helm firstwhat needs a hand

acts board of dated next acts and machine lines with controls inline · positions beneath

P7 — The life beyondthe world is the axis

deployments: sites, houses, flocks, readings, attempts with their controls

P8 — Capital by vintagemoney over time is the hero

in vs returned by vintage · positions grouped by vintage · money first in the drawer

P9 — The machine's own scorecardcalibration is the hero

claims scored, coverage, the calibration curve · positions grouped by thesis-vs-reality state

P10 — Bets that fail togetherexposure is the structure

positions arranged by shared mechanism, climate, feed, regulation · signals attach to clusters

P11 — The published bookproof of work

each position a publication entry with receipts · owner controls subordinate

P12 — The workstation, transplantedSimulation grammar

status bar · POSITIONS · SELECTED POSITION residual chart · INSPECTOR · timeline · acts

P13 — The ledgerbook of actsEngine Room grammar

a dated journal of every act and event, controls beside each line · positions ledger · position ledgers
